name: unique
description: Generates visuals that are unique to the product they are for. Frames the product, routes every capability to the best stack for that job (3D, particles, data viz, editors, realtime, AI UI), commits to a design contract that separates 'make it unique' from 'as good as Stripe' from 'match our system', carries real landing-page doctrine, a repertoire of devices on five axes to replace the defaults it bans, and a derived component grammar so the tokens do not land on the default control shapes, then builds, renders the result and scores it on screen, and audits against real performance and accessibility budgets with the command behind every number. The doctrine is enforced by dependency-free scripts rather than executed in the head: a palette generator that derives ground, ink and accent from one provenance fact and measures every pair before the tokens ship; a render pass that resolves its own browser and captures 390/768/1440 plus 320px and 200% zoom; and a contract checker that fails a missing grid block, a missing component grammar or one of its keys left with no value, a provenance fact that is a mood, an unscored rubric, or a repeated palette/face/layout triple across the divergence log. Generation is treated as the harder half: facts are looked up rather than recalled from eight named wells, three whole art directions are generated from three different facts and two killed on the brief's terms before any token exists, the trend press is explicitly not an input because a trend list describes the mean, and the variance rule names where a page is deliberately uneven — density, scale, one motion moment — because uniform padding, radius and card height is the most reliable tell of a generated page. Color adds OKLCH harmony for categorical sets and APCA as a readability ceiling above the WCAG floor; type resolves a class table against libre foundries instead of the four family names every model already has; motion gets a choreography block and the CSS scroll-driven toolkit; composition gets a reading path and a density map before the grid.
